name: 143.3 — a petal of your own on the radial menu
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 143.3: s:flowermenu():add(label, fn) appends a petal the ring lays out, petal:native() tells whose a petal is, picking the addon's own runs fn(petal, s) and ends the ring carrying its label, and :add outside FlowerMenuAdded is refused.
